experiment: M1A — adaptive sweep boundary (minimal state-dependent feedback)

adaptive_rule.definition: D_t(j) = cumulative_mass(bins 1..j) - j/K; j_t = argmax_j D_t(j); a_t = j_t/K; sweep active iff D_max(t) > stop_tolerance
adaptive_rule.status: Model Assumption: minimal mathematical abstraction of the real observation that the operator looks at the current surface and then decides where to sweep. NOT a real-world stopping rule.
adaptive_rule.tolerance_note: numerical implementation of the mathematical condition D_max <= 0 (no prefix holds cumulative near-side excess); frozen, never tuned
